verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data export capability for Workers or its data stores (KV, D1, R2), such as SQL dumps or bulk export in open formats. The marketing line "No proprietary tools or vendor lock-in" refers to developer workflow tooling (Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code), not data portability, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. A community comment also describes KV and D1 as locked-in and hard to switch away from.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
